note: Popcorn and marshmallow caramel balls rolled in rainbow sprinkles

steps.text: Pop the kernels in the oil in a covered pot and tip into a big bowl, discarding unpopped kernels.
Melt the butter, marshmallows and brown sugar over low heat, stirring until smooth, with a pinch of salt.
Pour over the popcorn and stir quickly to coat. Cool briefly.
With buttered hands squeeze into balls and roll in the sprinkles.
Set on baking paper.

note: Chicken salted chips with melted cheddar and beef gravy

steps.text: Bake the chips at 220C, turning once, then toss with chicken salt.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the stock and Worcestershire. Simmer until thick and glossy.
Pile the chips on a platter, scatter with cheddar and pour over the hot gravy.
Finish with chives.

note: One giant pancake with maple syrup, banana and crumbled bacon

ingredients.item: rashers bacon, cooked crisp and crumbled

steps.text: Whisk the flour, sugar and a pinch of salt. Whisk in the eggs, buttermilk and some melted butter until just combined.
Heat a large 28cm non-stick pan over low heat and grease with butter. Pour in all the batter and cover with a lid.
Cook until bubbles set on top.
Slide onto a plate, flip back in and cook the other side.
Top with butter, maple syrup, banana and crumbled bacon.

note: Panko crumbed flathead bites with homemade tartare sauce

dish.n: Lakeside crumbed fish bites with tartare

steps.text: Cut the fish into bite-size pieces.
Toss in flour, dip in egg, then coat in panko.
Shallow fry at 180C, turning once, until golden. Drain.
Mix the mayonnaise with the capers, pickles, parsley and a squeeze of lemon.
Serve hot with the tartare and lemon wedges.

note: Toasted marshmallow, chocolate and caramel sandwiched between biscuits

steps.text: Lay half the biscuits on a lined tray. Top some with milk chocolate and the rest with dark chocolate and a little caramel.
Thread the marshmallows onto skewers and toast over a fire or gas flame until golden, or grill on a tray.
Put marshmallows on each chocolate biscuit and press another biscuit on top. Eat while warm.

note: Cheddar pimento cheese spread with crackers and celery

dish.n: Boot camp crackers with pimento cheese
dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, keep chilled

ingredients.item: roasted red capsicum from a jar, chopped

steps.text: Mix the cheddar with the mayonnaise, capsicum, Worcestershire, cayenne and pepper, keeping it a little chunky.
Chill so the flavours settle.
Spoon into a bowl, dust with paprika and serve with crackers and celery sticks.

note: Cocktail franks glazed in honey, mustard and tomato sauce

steps.text: Score the frankfurts diagonally a few times each.
Fry in the oil until the cuts open up.
Add the tomato sauce, honey, mustard and Worcestershire and toss until sticky and glazed.
Serve on toothpicks with a pot of wholegrain mustard.

note: King prawns in a Bloody Mary cocktail sauce over shredded cos

dish.n: Country club Bloody Mary prawn cocktail

steps.text: Peel the prawns, leaving the tails on.
Mix the mayonnaise with the tomato sauce, horseradish, Worcestershire, hot sauce, celery salt and a squeeze of lemon.
Shred the lettuce into glasses and spoon over some sauce.
Hang the prawns around the rim, dust with paprika and serve with lemon wedges and a celery stick.

note: Crisp battered snapper bites with lime aioli

dish.n: Beach kiosk fish bites with lime aioli

steps.text: Cut the fish into bite-size pieces.
Whisk the flour, cornflour, baking powder and soda water into a batter.
Dip the fish and fry at 180C until crisp and golden, working in batches. Drain.
Mix the mayonnaise with the garlic and lime zest and juice.
Sprinkle the fish with sea salt and chilli flakes and serve with the aioli.
Mix the celery salt and pepper on a saucer, wet the rims of tall glasses with lemon and dip.
Fill the glasses with ice.
Stir the tomato juice, vodka, juice of one lemon, horseradish, Worcestershire and hot sauce in a jug.
Pour into the glasses and add a celery stick and a lemon wedge.

note: Creamy ham croquetas crumbed and fried, with lime garlic mayo

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled before frying

steps.text: Melt the butter, stir in some of the flour for a couple of minutes, then slowly whisk in the milk until very thick.
Stir in the ham, nutmeg and pepper. Spread on a tray, cover and chill.
Shape into small logs, roll in the remaining flour, dip in egg and coat in breadcrumbs.
Fry at 180C until golden, working in batches.
Mix the mayonnaise with the garlic and a squeeze of lime juice and serve for dipping.

note: Crisp fritters of chopped prawn, capsicum and spring onion

steps.text: Mix the flour, egg, soda water, capsicum, spring onions, Cajun seasoning and salt into a thick batter, then fold in the prawns.
Drop heaped tablespoons into oil at 180C and fry, turning, until golden. Drain.
Mix the mayonnaise, sweet chilli sauce and lime juice for the sauce.

note: Cornmeal crusted back bacon, fried onions and maple mustard on buns

dish.n: Peameal back bacon on a bun

steps.text: Cut the bacon into thick slices and press both sides into the cornmeal.
Fry in oil over medium heat, turning once, until golden and cooked through.
Fry the onions in the same pan.
Mix the mustard with the maple syrup. Split and toast the buns, spread with maple mustard and fill with bacon and onions.

note: Baked hot sauce wings with blue cheese dip and celery

steps.text: Toss the wings with the baking powder and salt.
Bake at 220C, turning once.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and toss the wings through it.
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream with a squeeze of lemon. Serve the wings hot with the dip and celery.

note: Prosciutto wrapped breadsticks with warm herbed olives and cheddar

steps.text: Wrap each breadstick with prosciutto, spiralling it around the top half.
Warm the olives in a small pan with the oil, orange zest, garlic and rosemary, then cool slightly.
Cube the cheddar.
Stand the grissini in a tall glass and serve with the olives and cheese.

note: Chicken salted chips with onion gravy

steps.text: Bake the chips at 220C, turning once, and toss with chicken salt while hot.
Melt the butter in a small pan and cook the onion.
Stir in the flour, then whisk in the stock and Worcestershire and simmer.
Strain into a jug. Serve the chips in a big basket with the gravy for pouring.

note: Liverwurst, mustard, pickles and red onion on rye, with cold buttermilk

dish.n: Midnight liverwurst on rye and buttermilk

steps.text: Spread the bread with butter and a thin layer of mustard.
Slice the liverwurst and lay it over half the slices. Top with pickles and red onion, then the other slices.
Press down, trim the crusts and cut into fingers.
Pour the buttermilk into small glasses and serve together.

note: Beef frank in a poppy seed bun with mustard, relish, tomato, pickle, peppers

steps.text: Simmer the frankfurts in water, then grill briefly for colour.
Steam or warm the buns and sprinkle the tops with poppy seeds.
Put a frankfurt in each bun, add mustard and relish, then onion, tomato, a pickle spear and pickled peppers.
Finish with a pinch of celery salt.
Heat the milk until steaming, then whisk in the chocolate and cocoa until smooth and frothy.
Pour into heatproof mugs, pile marshmallows on top and put the mugs on a tray under a hot grill, watching closely, until puffed and golden.
Dust with cinnamon and serve.

note: Cooked king prawns with lime and hot sauce cocktail dressing

steps.text: Peel the prawns, leaving the tails on.
Mix the mayonnaise with the tomato sauce, juice of one lime, hot sauce and Worcestershire.
Shred the lettuce into glasses and add cubes of avocado.
Spoon over the sauce and hang the prawns around the rims. Dust with paprika and serve with lime wedges.

note: Sponge, orange juice, berries, jelly, custard, cream and almonds

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

ingredients.item: mixed berries, plus a few extra to finish

steps.text: Make up the jelly with boiling water.
Break the sponge into a large glass bowl and drizzle with orange juice. Scatter over the berries.
Pour the cooled jelly over and chill until set.
Spoon the custard on top.
Whip the cream with the icing sugar and spread over. Finish with almonds and a few berries.

note: Mini bagels with chive cream cheese, smoked salmon, capers and dill

steps.text: Split the bagels and toast until golden.
Beat the cream cheese with the chives and a squeeze of lemon. Spread thickly on each bagel half.
Top with smoked salmon, capers, red onion and dill.
Finish with cracked pepper and serve on a board with lemon wedges.

note: Crisp baked wings tossed in hot sauce, butter and honey

dish.n: Nutcracka hunt hot honey buffalo wings

steps.text: Pat the wings dry and toss with the baking powder and salt.
Bake on a rack at 220C, turning once, until crisp.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and honey and toss the wings through.
Mix the sour cream, mayonnaise, buttermilk, herbs and garlic powder for the ranch.
Serve with carrot and celery sticks.

note: Beef and pork sausage rolls with caramelised onion in puff pastry

dish.n: Office party beef and onion sausage rolls

ingredients.item: eggs (1 for the filling, 1 beaten for glazing)

steps.text: Fry the onions in the butter until golden, then cool.
Mix the minces with the onions, thyme, breadcrumbs, one egg and salt.
Cut the pastry in half, lay a log of filling along each strip, roll and seal.
Brush with egg, sprinkle with sesame and cut into pieces.
Bake at 200C until golden. Serve with relish.

note: Pork, apple and sage sausage rolls in puff pastry

dish.n: Fezziwig's ball pork and sage rolls

steps.text: Mix the pork with the apple, onion, sage, breadcrumbs, salt and pepper.
Cut the pastry in half, lay a log of filling along each strip, roll and seal underneath.
Brush with egg and cut each into small rolls.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Stir the mustard into the chutney and serve alongside.

note: Slow-cooked onion dip with sour cream

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Slowly cook the onions in the butter and oil over low heat until jammy and deep brown.
Add the Worcestershire and a splash of water, scrape the pan, then cool.
Mix with the sour cream, cream cheese, most of the chives and salt.
Chill the dip.
Top with crispy shallots and chives and serve with kettle chips.

note: Warm blinis with crème fraîche, hot-smoked salmon and salmon roe

steps.text: Warm the blinis on a tray at 180C.
Mix the creme fraiche with the lemon zest and a pinch of salt. Flake the smoked salmon.
Top each blini with creme fraiche, a few flakes of salmon and a little roe.
Finish with chives and cracked pepper and serve with lemon wedges.

note: Chipotle chicken, charred corn, feta and lime crema in corn tortillas

steps.text: Soak the onion in the juice of two limes with a pinch of salt and sugar.
Toss the chicken with the chipotle sauce, cumin and oil, grill on both sides and slice.
Char the corn and cut off the kernels.
Mix the sour cream with lime juice. Warm the tortillas.
Fill with chicken, corn, feta, crema, onion and coriander.

note: Grilled beef and lamb sausages in soft rolls with ajvar and sour cream

dish.n: Covent Garden cevapi rolls with ajvar

steps.text: Mix the minces with the garlic, paprika, bicarb and salt and knead briefly.
Roll into short fingers and chill.
Grill over high heat, turning, until charred.
Split and toast the rolls and spread with ajvar.
Add cevapi to each and top with sour cream, onion and parsley.

note: Shortcrust mince pies served with orange cream

dish.n: Santa's shop mince pies with orange cream

steps.text: Cut rounds from two pastry sheets and press into a greased patty pan tin.
Fill each with fruit mince. Cut stars from the third sheet and lay on top.
Brush with egg and bake at 190C until golden.
Whip the cream with some of the icing sugar, the orange zest and brandy.
Dust the warm pies with icing sugar and serve with the orange cream.

note: Creamy tomato soup with sourdough cheddar and mozzarella toasties

dish.n: Mary's grilled cheese and tomato soup

steps.text: Fry the onion and garlic in the oil until soft.
Add the tomatoes, paprika, sugar and stock and simmer.
Blitz the soup smooth and stir in the cream.
Butter the outsides of the sourdough and fill with the cheddar and mozzarella.
Fry over medium heat until golden on both sides. Cut into fingers and serve with the soup.

note: Creamy clam chowder with bacon, potato and celery

steps.text: Fry the bacon until crisp, add the onion and celery and cook until soft.
Stir in the flour, then the stock, potato and thyme and simmer.
Add the clams, cover and cook until open, then remove the empty shells.
Stir in the cream and heat through. Season with pepper and serve with oyster crackers.

note: Crisp potato skins with cheddar, bacon, sour cream and chilli honey

dish.n: MORA command centre loaded potato skins

steps.text: Prick the potatoes and bake at 200C until tender.
Halve, scoop out most of the flesh and brush the skins with melted butter and salt.
Bake skin-side up, then flip.
Fill with cheddar and bacon and bake until melted.
Top with sour cream, spring onion and jalapenos, and drizzle with honey mixed with chilli flakes.

note: Beef in garlic oregano jus piled onto small rolls

steps.text: Simmer the stock with the garlic, oregano, chilli and Worcestershire.
Drop in the roast beef briefly to warm through.
Split the buns and dip the cut sides quickly in the jus.
Pile in the beef and top with pickled vegetables. Serve with little cups of jus for dunking.

dish.n: Sleigh ride salted caramel hot chocolate

steps.text: Heat the milk until steaming, then whisk in the chocolate and most of the caramel sauce until smooth.
Pour into mugs and top with whipped cream and a drizzle of caramel.
Add marshmallows and brown quickly with a kitchen torch or under the grill.

note: Crisp cheese toasties cut in fingers, with homemade tomato soup

dish.n: Snow day toastie fingers with tomato soup

steps.text: Fry the onion in the oil until soft.
Add the tomatoes, stock and sugar and simmer, then blitz smooth and stir in the cream.
Spread the bread with mustard and make sandwiches with ham and cheddar. Butter the outsides.
Fry until golden on both sides.
Cut into fingers and serve with cups of soup.

note: Grilled franks in pretzel buns with slow-fried onions and mustard

steps.text: Slowly fry the onions in the butter until golden.
Simmer the frankfurts in water, then grill briefly for colour.
Warm the buns in the oven.
Split the buns, add a frankfurt to each and top with onions, mustard, pickles and cheddar.

note: Baked beef and pork meatballs glazed in cranberry sweet chilli sauce

steps.text: Mix the minces with the egg, breadcrumbs, garlic and salt.
Roll into small balls and bake on a lined tray at 200C.
Simmer the cranberry sauce, sweet chilli, soy and lemon juice until glossy.
Toss the meatballs through, scatter with spring onion and serve on toothpicks.

note: Sponge, orange juice, strawberry jelly, custard and cream

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Make up the jelly with boiling water and cool.
Break the sponge into a glass bowl, drizzle with orange juice and add the berries. Pour over the jelly.
Chill until set.
Spoon over the custard.
Whip the cream with the icing sugar and spread on top. Scatter with honeycomb just before serving.

note: Shortcrust fruit mince pies with star tops

steps.text: Cut rounds from two pastry sheets and press into a greased patty pan tin.
Fill each with fruit mince. Cut stars from the third sheet and lay on top.
Brush with egg and bake at 190C until golden.
Whip the cream with some of the icing sugar and the orange zest.
Dust the warm pies with icing sugar and serve with the cream.

note: Pork, apple and sage sausage rolls in puff pastry

dish.n: Christmas fair pork and apple rolls

steps.text: Mix the sausage mince with the apple, onion, sage and breadcrumbs.
Cut the pastry in half, lay a log of filling along each strip, roll up and seal underneath.
Brush with egg, sprinkle with sesame seeds and cut into pieces.
Bake at 200C until golden. Serve with relish.

note: Milk chocolate with mini marshmallows and jellybeans

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 week, keep chilled

steps.text: Line a 20cm square tin with baking paper.
Melt the chocolate with the butter in a bowl over simmering water, then cool briefly.
Stir in the marshmallows, most of the jellybeans, pretzels and coconut.
Spread into the tin and press more jellybeans on top.
Chill until set, then cut into squares with a hot knife.

note: Crisp baked wings glazed in sticky barbecue sauce

steps.text: Toss the wings with the baking powder, paprika and salt.
Bake on a rack at 220C, turning once.
Simmer the barbecue sauce with the honey and hot sauce, toss the wings through and bake again.
Mix the sour cream, mayonnaise, chives and garlic powder for the ranch.
Scatter the wings with spring onion and serve with the ranch.

note: Mini bagels with cream cheese and everything seasoning

steps.text: Mix the seeds, onion flakes, garlic flakes and salt for the seasoning.
Beat the cream cheese with the spring onions until fluffy.
Grill the bacon until crisp and crumble.
Split and toast the bagels.
Spread with the cream cheese, top with bacon and sprinkle with the seasoning.

note: Blue jelly, vanilla ice cream, cream, biscuit sand and gummy fish

steps.text: Make up the jelly with boiling water and pour into a shallow dish.
Set the jelly in the fridge, then cut into cubes.
Crush the biscuits into sand.
In tall glasses layer jelly cubes, ice cream and more jelly.
Top with whipped cream, biscuit sand, gummy fish and a drizzle of chocolate sauce.

note: Cheddar and roasted capsicum spread with crackers

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Finely grate the cheddar.
Mix with the mayonnaise, chopped capsicum, Worcestershire, cayenne and black pepper until combined but still chunky.
Chill in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Spoon into a bowl, dust with paprika and serve with crackers, celery sticks and cornichons.

note: Crisp tortilla rounds with prawns and avocado

dish.n: Laura's prawn and avocado tostada bites
dish.make_ahead: Crisps and onion up to 1 day ahead, assemble just before serving

steps.text: Cut small rounds from the tortillas with a 6cm cutter and brush with oil.
Bake at 200C until crisp, then cool.
Toss the peeled prawns with lime juice and chilli flakes.
Mash the avocados with lime juice and salt.
Thinly slice the red onion.
Soak the onion in lime juice for 10 minutes.
Top each crisp with avocado, a prawn, a few onion slivers and a coriander leaf.

note: Spiced chicken skewers on pita with white sauce and hot sauce

dish.n: Times Square halal cart chicken skewers
dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Dice the chicken and toss with oil, lemon juice, cumin, turmeric, coriander, crushed garlic and salt.
Marinate in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Thread the chicken onto skewers.
Mix the mayonnaise, yoghurt, vinegar, crushed garlic and a pinch of sugar into a white sauce.
Grill the skewers, turning, until cooked through.
Warm the pita and shred the lettuce.
Serve the skewers on pita with white sauce, chilli sauce and lettuce.

note: Dark chocolate and cream fondue with orange zest, strawberries to dip

dish.make_ahead: Chocolate sauce up to 1 day ahead, reheat gently

steps.text: Chop the chocolate and prepare the dippers on a platter.
Heat the cream until steaming.
Pour over the chocolate and leave to melt.
Stir until glossy, then stir in orange zest and a pinch of salt.
Keep warm in a fondue pot or a bowl over hot water.
Serve with strawberries, marshmallows, brownie cubes and pretzels on skewers.

note: Cheddar, ham, apple, pickled onions and homemade apple chutney

dish.make_ahead: Chutney up to 1 week ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Dice the apple and onion.
Simmer with brown sugar, cider vinegar and mixed spice until thick and sticky, then cool.
Slice the loaf and cut the cheddar into wedges.
Slice the remaining apples.
Arrange on a board with the sliced ham, pickled onions and chutney.

note: Lemon crab mayo and cress on buttered soft white bread

dish.n: Cornish beach crab and cress sandwiches
dish.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep covered and chilled

steps.text: Mix the crab with mayonnaise, lemon zest and juice, cayenne and salt.
Butter the bread slices.
Spread the crab over half the slices, add thin cucumber slices and cress, then close.
Press gently, trim the crusts and cut each sandwich into fingers.

note: Shortcrust pasties of beef, potato, swede and onion, brown sauce

dish.make_ahead: Assemble a day ahead, bake fresh

steps.text: Finely dice the rump, potato, swede and onion and mix with salt and pepper.
Cut rounds from the pastry sheets.
Spoon filling onto one half of each, add a small knob of butter, fold over and crimp the edge.
Brush with beaten egg and cut a small slit.
Bake at 190C until golden.
Serve with brown sauce.

note: Roasted mini sausages glazed in honey and wholegrain mustard

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat in a hot oven

steps.text: Twist each chipolata in half and snip apart into little sausages.
Roast on a lined tray at 200C.
Mix the honey, wholegrain mustard and soy sauce.
Pour over the sausages, toss and roast until sticky and glazed.
Scatter with thyme leaves and serve on toothpicks.

note: Crisp baked wings in smoky paprika dry rub, barbecue mustard dip

dish.make_ahead: Rub up to 1 day ahead, cook fresh

steps.text: Mix the paprika, brown sugar, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne and salt.
Toss the wings with baking powder and the rub.
Bake on a rack at 220C, turning once.
Mix the barbecue sauce, mustard and vinegar for dipping.

note: Creamy pickle yolk filling topped with crisp bacon and chives

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Cook the eggs in boiling water.
Cool in iced water, then peel.
Halve the eggs and scoop the yolks into a bowl.
Mash with mayonnaise, mustard, chopped pickles and salt.
Pipe back into the whites.
Grill the bacon until crisp and crumble.
Top the eggs with bacon, a dusting of smoked paprika and chives.

note: Pork, wombok and ginger dumplings pan-fried until crisp underneath

dish.make_ahead: Filling up to 1 day ahead, fill and fry fresh

steps.text: Finely chop the wombok and salt it.
Leave the wombok for 10 minutes, then squeeze dry.
Mix with the pork mince, ginger, spring onions, soy and sesame oil.
Fill the dumpling wrappers, wet the edges and pleat closed.
Fry in oil until golden underneath.
Add water, cover and steam until dry.
Mix the black vinegar, soy and chilli oil for dipping.

note: Crisp fried pork spring rolls with vinegar and sweet chilli dips

dish.make_ahead: Roll up to 1 day ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Mix the pork mince with grated carrot, onion, garlic, spring onions, egg, soy and pepper.
Lay filling along the edge of each wrapper in a thin line and roll up tightly, sealing with water.
Fry at 180C until deep golden.
Mix the white vinegar with crushed garlic, chilli and pepper.
Serve with the vinegar and sweet chilli sauce.

note: Stir-fried rice noodles with chicken, Chinese sausage and vegetables

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled and reheat

steps.text: Soak the vermicelli in hot water, then drain.
Slice the chicken, sausage, onion, cabbage and carrot.
Stir-fry the chicken and sausage in oil.
Add the onion, garlic, cabbage, carrot and snow peas.
Add the stock, soy and oyster sauce, then the noodles, and toss until absorbed.
Serve with lime or calamansi wedges and spring onion.

note: Bacon wrapped sausages glazed in maple, cranberry mustard dip

dish.make_ahead: Wrap up to 1 day ahead, roast fresh

steps.text: Cut the bacon rashers in half and wrap each chipolata.
Lay on a lined tray and roast at 200C, turning once, until crisp.
Brush with maple syrup for the last few minutes.
Mix the cranberry sauce with wholegrain mustard for dipping and serve hot on toothpicks.

note: Panko crumbed crab cakes with spring onion and lemon aioli

dish.n: Georgia's crab cakes with lemon aioli
dish.make_ahead: Shape up to 1 day ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Mix the crab with mayonnaise, egg, spring onions, lemon zest, Dijon and panko.
Shape into small cakes.
Chill for 30 minutes.
Roll in more panko.
Fry in oil over medium heat until golden each side.
Mix the mayonnaise with crushed garlic and lemon juice.
Serve with the aioli and a few dressed rocket and parsley leaves.

note: Pipis steamed open in garlic, chilli, lemon butter, with crusty bread

dish.make_ahead: Cook just before serving

steps.text: Soak the pipis in cold salted water to purge the sand, then rinse.
Slice the garlic and chilli.
Fry the garlic and chilli in olive oil.
Add the pipis and fish stock, cover and steam until they open, discarding any that stay shut.
Stir in butter, lemon juice and parsley.
Serve with crusty bread.

note: Cos and butter lettuce, anchovy parmesan dressing, egg, croutons

dish.make_ahead: Dressing and croutons up to 1 day ahead, toss just before serving

steps.text: Tear the bread roll into chunks, toss with olive oil and crushed garlic.
Bake at 190C until golden.
Cook the eggs, then cool and halve.
Mash the anchovies with garlic, then whisk in Dijon, lemon juice, mayonnaise and parmesan.
Tear the cos and butter lettuce into a big bowl.
Toss with the dressing and croutons and top with the eggs and more parmesan.

note: Corned beef, cheddar, lettuce and mustard pickle in soft rolls

dish.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep covered and chilled

steps.text: Split and butter the rolls.
Spread each base generously with mustard pickle.
Layer with thickly sliced corned beef, a slice of cheddar and a few leaves of iceberg lettuce.
Add thinly sliced tomato and a crack of pepper, close and cut in half.

film: Danger Close: The Battle of Long Tan (2019)
note: Lemongrass chicken skewers with peanut satay sauce

dish.n: Nui Dat concert night satay skewers
dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead, grill fresh

steps.text: Dice the chicken and toss with chopped lemongrass, turmeric, garlic, fish sauce and brown sugar.
Marinate in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill, turning.
Simmer the peanut butter, coconut milk, soy, brown sugar, chilli and lime juice into a satay sauce.
Serve with cucumber and lime wedges.

film: Danger Close: The Battle of Long Tan (2019)
note: Fresh rolls of prawn, vermicelli, carrot and cucumber

dish.n: Phuoc Tuy prawn rice paper rolls
dish.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep covered with damp paper towel

steps.text: Soak the vermicelli in hot water, then drain.
Halve the prawns lengthways.
Julienne the carrot and cucumber.
Dip the rice paper sheets one at a time in warm water for a few seconds.
Lay prawns, noodles, vegetables, mint and coriander on each and roll tightly.
Mix the fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, water, garlic and chilli for dipping.

note: Grilled Italian sausage with capsicum and onion in a toasted roll

dish.make_ahead: Peppers up to 1 day ahead, reheat

steps.text: Slice the capsicums and onions.
Fry over medium heat until soft and sweet, seasoning with salt and oregano.
Grill the sausages, turning, then split lengthways.
Toast the long rolls.
Fill with sausage, pile on the peppers and onions and finish with mustard.

note: Franks in toasted buns with fried onions, mustard, relish and cheddar

dish.make_ahead: Onions up to 1 day ahead, reheat

steps.text: Slice the onions.
Slowly fry the onions in butter until golden.
Simmer the frankfurts.
Grill the frankfurts for colour.
Toast the hot dog buns, no more and no less.
Fill each with a frankfurt, the onions, a squeeze of mustard, a spoon of relish and grated cheddar.

note: Warm blinis with lemon crème fraîche and smoked salmon

dish.make_ahead: Topping up to 4 hours ahead, assemble just before serving

steps.text: Warm the blinis at 180C.
Mix the creme fraiche with lemon zest and a pinch of salt.
Top each blini with creme fraiche, a ribbon of smoked salmon, capers and a sliver of red onion.
Finish with a dill sprig and cracked pepper and serve with lemon wedges.

note: Ham, salami and provolone sub with oregano vinaigrette and pickled peppers

dish.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep wrapped and chilled

steps.text: Whisk the olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano and pepper into a dressing.
Split the baguettes and drizzle the insides with half the dressing.
Layer with sliced ham, salami and provolone.
Top with shredded iceberg, sliced tomato, thin red onion and pickled peppers, then the rest of the dressing.
Press closed and wrap tightly.
Rest wrapped for 10 minutes.
Cut each baguette into pieces.

note: Franks in toasted buns with beef chilli and melted cheddar

dish.make_ahead: Chilli up to 2 days ahead, grill fresh

steps.text: Dice the onions.
Brown the mince with the onion.
Add the cumin, paprika, chilli powder, passata and water and simmer until thick.
Grill the frankfurts.
Toast the hot dog buns.
Fill each with a frankfurt, spoon over the chilli, scatter with grated cheddar and grill to melt.
Top with diced white onion and mustard.

note: Sliced meatloaf with cheddar, pickles and relish on toasted bread

dish.make_ahead: Meatloaf up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Mix the mince, grated onion, egg, breadcrumbs, Worcestershire and salt.
Press into a lined loaf tin and spread with tomato sauce mixed with brown sugar.
Bake at 180C.
Cool completely, then slice thickly.
Toast the bread.
Fill with the meatloaf, cheddar, pickles and tomato relish and cut in half.

note: Bratwurst simmered in lager, grilled, with beer onions and mustard

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat gently

steps.text: Slice the onions.
Simmer the bratwurst in lager with the onions and butter.
Lift out the brats and grill, turning, until charred.
Keep boiling the onions until the liquid reduces and they turn sticky.
Toast the rolls.
Fill with a brat and a pile of beer onions and finish with wholegrain mustard.

note: Mini beef pies with puff lids, served with tomato sauce

dish.n: Flemington Cup day beef party pies
dish.make_ahead: Filling up to 2 days ahead, bake fresh

steps.text: Dice the onions.
Brown the mince with the onion.
Stir in the flour, then the stock, tomato sauce, Worcestershire and plenty of pepper and simmer until thick.
Cool the filling.
Cut bases from the shortcrust pastry and press into a greased patty pan tin.
Fill, top with rounds of puff pastry and brush with egg.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Serve with tomato sauce.
